Method of Attack: Supply-chain attack inserting a backdoor payload into compromised game executables
Malware checks system region to avoid infecting Chinese or Russian machines
Backdoor decrypts and runs in-memory before game or platform code
Backdoor communicates with command-and-control server, supports commands to download and run files, and uninstall itself
Second stage payload installs as Windows service and auto-updates (function unknown)
Impacted Systems: Infestation game by Electronics Extreme (Thai developer)
Two other unnamed games and a gaming platform developed by Asian companies
Attack Vector: Supply-chain attack via compromised game and platform executables
Indicators of Compromise: Command-and-control server URLs in configuration files
Registry key HKCU\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ImageFlag set to 1 to disable backdoor
Backdoor commands: DownUrlFile, DownRunUrlFile, RunUrlBinInMem, UnInstall
